title: Create a service
summary: Each treatment you offer, with price and duration. The duration sets the appointment length when it's booked.

steps.title: Service name
steps.details: It's what's chosen when booking, quoting and invoicing.

steps.title: Category
steps.details: Required: groups services in lists, reports and the portal.

steps.title: Price
steps.details: List price in the stated currency. It can be adjusted on each quote or invoice.
steps.description: In the clinic's main currency, unless you choose another one next to it.

steps.title: Duration (minutes)
steps.details: Sets the appointment length when booking this service. If an appointment has several services, they add up.
steps.description: It's how long the appointment takes on the calendar.

steps.title: Save the service
steps.details: Saves the service as active. If you check "Bookable online", the patient can also book it from the portal.
